verdict.rationale: A SaaS incorporation service could plausibly ship a built-in AI assistant, so this story applies to Stripe Atlas. Nothing in the evidence shows one. The documented automations (EIN filing, 83(b) elections, signature sequencing, share purchase) are fixed workflow steps, not a delegable AI assistant. The llms.txt probe only serves documentation to external agents, and the community remark that Atlas felt 'like having an advisor' is a metaphor. None of these earn credit for this story.
